result.instructions: Tools for Shippit, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Quote shipping for a 2 kg parcel to Pyrmont NSW 2009 and show all carriers."; "Where is my order PPuqD0J0uLslM and what is its tracking history?"; "Create a standard order for 1 parcel of 1.5 kg to 1 Union Street, Pyrmont NSW 2009 for John Smith.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Shippit data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run shippit_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run shippit_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run shippit_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. shippit_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: shippit_get_merchant
tools.title: Get merchant account
tools.description: The Shippit merchant account behind this API key: store and company name, contact, preparation time, website and the home (pickup) address with country. GET /merchant.

tools.name: shippit_get_operating_hours
tools.title: Get store operating hours
tools.description: The store operating hours per weekday (open flag, start and end of the working day) that Shippit uses for pickup and delivery estimates. GET /merchants/settings/locations/operating_hours.

tools.name: shippit_list_webhooks
tools.title: List webhooks
tools.description: The tracking webhooks configured on the account (at most 6): url, the order states that trigger each, whether address or receiver details are hidden, enabled flag. Custom header values are masked by Shippit. GET /merchants/webhooks.

tools.name: shippit_get_quotes
tools.title: Get shipping quotes
tools.description: Ask the carriers enabled on the account for a price and delivery estimate to a destination, for given parcels. Nothing is booked and nothing is charged. Set return_all_quotes to see every carrier instead of only the cheapest or fastest. A 200 can hold per-carrier errors (success false) and a quote of 0 means that carrier cannot take the parcel. Dangerous goods cannot be quoted. POST /quotes.

dropoff_state.description: State. Australian orders use NSW, VIC, QLD, WA, SA, TAS, ACT or NT.

dropoff_country_code.description: Two-letter country code (default: the merchant's home country, usually AU).

qty.description: Number of parcels of this kind.

weight.description: Weight of one parcel in kilograms.

return_all_quotes.description: Return the quotes of all carriers (default: only the cheapest or fastest).

order_date.description: Delivery date, yyyy-mm-dd (required for priority quotes).

dutiable_amount.description: Declared customs value (required for international quotes).

authority_to_leave.description: Whether the parcel may be left unattended.

tools.name: shippit_estimate_delivery_dates
tools.title: Estimate delivery dates
tools.description: Estimated delivery window (earliest, latest, confidence and a ready-to-show text) per service level (standard, express) between two postcodes, optionally limited to some carriers. Returns an empty list if no carrier is enabled. POST /estimated_delivery_dates.

couriers.description: Carrier keywords to estimate for, e.g. CouriersPlease (default: all enabled).

preparation_time.description: Lead time before pickup as DD:HH:MM, e.g. 01:05:30.

tools.name: shippit_get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: One Shippit order by tracking number: state, courier and price allocated, delivery address, receiver, parcels, products, references and (once booked) manifest id and number. There is no list-orders endpoint in the Shippit API. GET /orders/{tracking_number}.

tracking_number.description: The Shippit tracking number of the order (returned by shippit_create_order; usually starts with PP).

tools.name: shippit_get_tracking
tools.title: Get order tracking
tools.description: The status history of an order (status, date, time, who changed it) and the public tracking page URL to give the recipient. GET /orders/{tracking_number}/tracking.

tracking_number.description: The Shippit tracking number of the order (returned by shippit_create_order; usually starts with PP).

tools.name: shippit_get_manifest_document
tools.title: Get manifest document
tools.description: The booking manifest document for a manifest id (from shippit_book_orders or shippit_get_order): carrier, order count, tracking numbers and a pre-signed PDF URL valid for 7 days. A 422 means the manifest is still generating: retry shortly. GET /book/{manifest_id}/document.

manifest_id.description: The Shippit manifest id (not the carrier's manifest number).

tools.name: shippit_create_order
tools.title: Create order
tools.description: WRITE: create a domestic shipping order in Shippit. Shippit then allocates a carrier (your account rules, or the carrier named in courier_allocation) and, unless suppress_communications is true, emails the recipient tracking notifications. Requires confirm: true. Standard, express and click-and-collect orders are only booked with the carrier later, by shippit_label_order and shippit_book_orders (priority and on-demand orders, which book inside the create request, are not supported here). validate defaults to true: the order is not saved when the suburb and postcode do not match (a suggested address is returned instead). Creating twice creates two orders. International orders (customs data) are not supported here. POST /orders.

courier_type.description: Service level (default standard). Give this or courier_allocation.

courier_allocation.description: A specific carrier keyword, e.g. CouriersPlease (see the Shippit carriers list). Instead of courier_type.

delivery_state.description: State. Australian orders use NSW, VIC, QLD, WA, SA, TAS, ACT or NT.

delivery_country_code.description: Two-letter country code (default: the merchant's home country, usually AU).

delivery_instructions.description: Instructions for the driver, at most 55 characters.

authority_to_leave.description: Whether the parcel may be left unattended.

receiver_name.description: Name of the person receiving it, if different from the customer.

customer_email.description: The customer's email (Shippit sends tracking notifications here unless suppressed).

qty.description: Number of parcels of this kind (required unless products are given).

weight.description: Weight of one parcel in kilograms.

parcels.description: The parcels (qty and weight are the minimum; leave qty out when you also send products).

products.description: Optional line items for the packing slip.

title.description: Product title (needed for international orders; shown on the packing slip).

price.description: Unit price (used for the packing slip, customs and transit protection).

retailer_invoice.description: Your order number, printed on the label and packing slip.

features.description: Carrier add-on services; some need prior approval from Shippit.

validate.description: Reject the order if suburb and postcode do not match (default true).

suppress_communications.description: true = Shippit sends no tracking notifications to the customer for this order (default false: it does).

confirm.description: Must be true. The order is real: it can email the customer and, for a named on-demand carrier, book it at once. Ask the user to confirm first.

tools.name: shippit_label_order
tools.title: Label order
tools.description: WRITE: confirm an order for shipping and fetch its label. This is the Shippit 'label' step: it finalises the carrier and price (the order moves to Ready to Ship) and returns the carrier, tracking and consignment details plus pre-signed PDF URLs (valid 7 days) for the shipping label, packing slip and any customs documents. A 422 means the order is still processing or has no valid carrier or quote: retry shortly or read the error. Labelling is the step before shippit_book_orders. GET /orders/{tracking_number}/label.

tracking_number.description: The Shippit tracking number of the order (returned by shippit_create_order; usually starts with PP).

tools.name: shippit_book_orders
tools.title: Book orders with carriers
tools.description: WRITE: book labelled orders with their carriers for pickup (the Shippit 'book' step). Shippit returns one manifest per carrier; the carrier then collects and bills the parcels. Orders must have been labelled first (shippit_label_order). The call fails as a whole when a tracking number is unknown; otherwise each manifest reports success or an error per order. Booked orders can no longer be edited. Requires confirm: true. A reply where every manifest failed is an error. POST /book.

items.description: The Shippit tracking number of the order (returned by shippit_create_order; usually starts with PP).

tracking_numbers.description: Tracking numbers of the labelled orders to book.

confirm.description: Must be true. Booking commits the orders to carrier pickup and charges; ask the user to confirm first.

tools.name: shippit_cancel_order
tools.title: Cancel order
tools.description: WRITE: cancel a Shippit order by tracking number (the order ends in state cancelled and cannot be revived; for some carriers Shippit also sends a cancellation request to the carrier). Shippit refuses with a 422 and the reason when the order can no longer be cancelled, for example once the carrier has it. Requires confirm: true. DELETE /orders/{tracking_number}.

tracking_number.description: The Shippit tracking number of the order (returned by shippit_create_order; usually starts with PP).

confirm.description: Must be true. A cancelled order cannot be recovered; ask the user to confirm first.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Shippit
prompts.description: What you can do with Shippit here, with example requests to try.
